principles: Preserve every original source field in raw_record.
Never generate a Thai definition from an English translation.
Keep source-specific senses separate from all other datasets.
Reject only records that cannot identify a lexical item or provide usable lexical evidence.

quality_flags.missing-definition: The source has no t-def; retain only source translation evidence.
quality_flags.missing-source-entry: The source has no t-entry; use t-search as written_form.
quality_flags.unmapped-pos: The source POS is unknown or dirty; preserve it and omit lexinfo:partOfSpeech.
